_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/choice/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 420x560; root column, padding 20, gap 12, alignItems flex-start. Children in order: tree (size [240, null]), combobox (width 220), datePicker (width 200). tree height = 5 rows x 26 = 130, so the stack is tr y=20, cb y=20+130+12=162, dp y=162+34+12=208.
_derivation.rows: expanded = ['src'] and items = src[ a, b ], lib[ c ], readme, so the visible rows are src(depth 0), a(1), b(1), lib(0), readme(0) at y = 20, 46, 72, 98, 124 (rowHeight 26).
_derivation.twisty: TreeWidget draws a 10x9 triangle whose centre x is (row left + TREE_PAD 22 + depth*18) - 13. Depth 0 -> cx = 20+22-13 = 29. src is OPEN (down triangle, spans y 30..37 at cx) and lib is CLOSED (right triangle, widest at cy = 98+13 = 111). readme is a LEAF and must draw nothing, so that pixel is the tree's own background.
points: (29,31) is inside the OPEN triangle of row src -> #6b7280 (OverlayChrome.TREE_TWISTY).
(29,111) is the widest point of the CLOSED triangle of row lib -> #6b7280.
(29,137) is on row readme (a leaf): no twisty, so the tree's background #f9fafb.
(200,59) is inside row a, which is the selected row -> ITEM_SELECTED #dbeafe.
(250,30) is inside row src, which paints no background of its own, so the TREE background #f9fafb shows through -- x=300 would be outside the 240-wide tree.
_derivation.final_frame: After the interaction phases the model is restored to expanded ['src'], selectedKey 'a', combobox closed with an empty query, datePicker closed with the value the probe picked (2026-10-15) -- exactly the state these rects describe. The mid-run states (3 rows after collapsing src, 4 after expanding lib, the filtered dropdown, the September grid) are asserted inside Main.as and reported through <OUT>.done; expect.json can only describe the final frame.
